applicability: After WS229 publishes its terminal HEAD/TREE. WS230 was NOT rebased onto WS229 and did NOT inspect unpublished WS229 local state. A future implementation successor fetches the terminal refs, evaluates every predicate below by machine-checkable path/blob comparison, and retains each WS230 finding only as its predicates allow.

classification_rule.DESIGN_REVALIDATION_REQUIRED: Wire shape or semantic detail changed in a way the WS230 facade/bounding design did not anticipate; finding retained only after human re-derivation against terminal source.
classification_rule.INVALIDATES_PREFLIGHT: Change contradicts a WS230 boundary fact (e.g. new lane, new identity alphabet, new authority allocation); affected WS230 rows must be re-done from terminal source.
classification_rule.NO_IMPACT: Byte-identical blobs or semantically neutral changes (comments, docs, unrelated modules); WS230 finding retained.

surfaces: protocol (message names, envelope fields, version consts)
decision frame (ids, offsets, classes, option shapes, numeric/assignment payloads)
numeric/assignment payload (keys, bounds, sentinel shapes, tiebreak/validation rules)
semantic replay (tape contract, fingerprint/digest algorithms, consumer steps)
process lifecycle (fresh-JVM discipline, cleanup, timeout, single-flight)
capability reporting (flag names, values, notes, lane declarations)

terminal_fields.rebase_ws230: FORBIDDEN (do not rebase WS230 onto WS229; successor starts from terminal CPL line + this contract)
